name: Charm, Captain’s
body:
Aura faint evocation and transmutation; CL 14th; Slot neck; Price 36,843 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This 4” long oval pendant must be worn by an active ship captain, on the outer most article of clothing, at the lapel level in order to function. It occasionally flashes with a glaring light, similar to sunlight reflected in a mirror.

Benefit: The wearer of this pendant gains a +6 enhancement bonus to Charisma and can cast flare 3 times per day.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, eagle’s splendor, flare; Cost 18,422 gp
